title: handoffs row (work_order, analysis_order, launch_order share one ledger)
description: Field table 04 L13-43 plus track from sync-inbox Q45(a)(f) L329-330. Which fields are required at which transition is the transition table's job (tables/transitions.json, 03 L17); this schema only fixes shapes and the few status-bound fields.

args.description: split from command is not ruled (21 L180)

track.description: copied from the parent work_order's top-level track (sync-inbox Q45(f))

config.description: four fixed keys, other hyper-parameters free (04 L43)

estimated_seconds.description: sum of this attempt's step_table only (04 L43)

actual_seconds.description: copied by rl from the runs finish version; never typed by a person (04 L43)

from_role.description: the owner; may be gyb (04 L19)

holder.description: session_id of the session working on it; non-empty iff status is in_progress (04 L21, L51)

last_holder.description: previous holder, moved here by rl when leaving in_progress; never cleared, not validated (04 L22)

parent_id.description: launch_order: required, points at the work order; analysis_order: optional; quick-lane supplement: empty (04 L24)

supersedes.description: set by reissue on the new order (04 L25, L76)

batch.description: caller free text; a launch_order copies it from the parent; rl does not assign it (04 L26)

line.description: computed by rl from the root_id of the first decision_refs item (04 L27); PENDING(issue 43d): refs may belong to several roots and the order then appears in every related line view (query layer)

adopted.description: optional on the start version; true when adopting a launched, unfinished run (04 L29)

ql_tag.description: required on a quick-lane supplement, points at the scratch row it merges back; empty otherwise (04 L31)

track.description: direction name on a work_order, filled by idea at open (required at open per proxy decision D-10); a launch_order carries it inside attempts[].track (sync-inbox Q45(a)(f) L329-330)

decision_refs.description: work_order: at least one; launch_order copies from the parent at open (04 L32)

evaluation_refs.description: analysis_order; items may be proposed at open, each must be approved to enter done_pending_review (04 L33)

explanation.description: work_order required; quick-lane supplement written by deploy and quoting gyb (04 L34)

report_paths.description: work_order entering done_pending_review: method required and existing; detail required and existing unless quick lane (04 L35)

code_paths.description: work_order entering done_pending_review: required; lists every code path this order changed, host files included (04 L36; sync-inbox Q45(d))

output_paths.description: analysis_order entering done_pending_review: required and existing (04 L37); PENDING(part 22 L117): repo path or analysis_artifact_root path, and two notebooks

progress_note.description: required only on the in_progress -> todo version (04 L39)

reason.description: required on rejected and withdrawn (04 L40)

quote.description: a withdrawal issued from a role session also carries gyb's words (04 L40)

x-conditions.source: 04 L32, L34; sync-inbox Q45(a) L329; track required at open per proxy decision D-10
04 L31 (a quick-lane supplement is quick_lane from its first version); PENDING(issue 41f): whether an order transferred by ql open --from carries ql_tag is not ruled

x-conditions.rule: transition-bound requirements (report_paths, code_paths, output_paths, approved refs, run finished ok) live in tables/transitions.json preconditions

x-pending: PENDING(part 22 L117): output_paths location and multiple notebooks
PENDING(part 20 L130): reissue inheritance of report_paths and code_paths
